card.name: Just before effective or metformin
card.fires_on: The word "effective" after "not be" or "an", the start of "metformin" after "and" in drug combinations, and "the" after "For" before "treatment".

modes.label: Effective in efficacy statements
modes.description: The word "effective" in sentences saying a product may not work or should not be relied on.

modes.description: The first piece of "metformin" after "and" or at a bullet start in combination-product labels.

modes.label: Small words before treatment
modes.description: "the" after "For" opening an indication phrase, or a closing bracket in chemotherapy text.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of "effective" and "effectiveness" as the next word, and raises odd name pieces.
